drivingQuestion: In which blessing is an error in prayer a bad omen?
outcomeNote: Patriarchs, in both versions of what the dictum is attached to

segments.en: «GEMARA:» We learned in the mishna that if one errs in his prayer it is a bad omen. The Gemara asks: «In which blessing» is an error a bad omen?

segments.he: אָמַר רַב חִיָּיא אָמַר רַב סָפְרָא מִשּׁוּם חַד דְּבֵי רַבִּי: בְּ״אָבוֹת״.
segments.en: «Rabbi Ḥiyya said» that «Rav Safra said in the name of one of the» Sages of the «school of Rabbi» Yehuda HaNasi: An error is a bad omen «in» the first blessing of the Amida prayer, the blessing of «Patriarchs».”

segments.he: אִיכָּא דְּמַתְנֵי לַהּ אַבָּרַיְיתָא: הַמִּתְפַּלֵּל צָרִיךְ שֶׁיְּכַוֵּין אֶת לִבּוֹ בְּכוּלָּן, וְאִם אֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לְכַוֵּין בְּכוּלָּן — יְכַוֵּין אֶת לִבּוֹ בְּאַחַת.
segments.en: «Some teach» that «this» statement was made «on a baraita» referring to another topic. It was taught in a baraita: «One who prays must focus his heart in all» of the blessings. «And if he is unable to focus» his heart «in all of them, he should focus his heart» at least «in one.»

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי חִיָּיא אָמַר רַב סָפְרָא מִשּׁוּם חַד דְּבֵי רַבִּי: בְּ״אָבוֹת״.
segments.en: Regarding this baraita, «Rabbi Ḥiyya said» that «Rav Safra said in the name of one of the» Sages of the «school of Rabbi» Yehuda HaNasi: «In» one refers to the blessing of «Patriarchs.»
